issue.title: Epic phase commits carry a stale SASE_PLAN tag from the launching agent, so all five sase-vd commits link the wrong plan
issue.description:
Every one of epic sase-vd's five phase commits carries
`SASE_PLAN=[202608/agents_v2_a_annotations.md]` — a completely unrelated plan. The correct
value is `202608/one_workspace_per_agent_family.md`, which is the plan linked to each
phase's own bead. The `SASE_BEAD=` tag on the same commits is correct, so the two tags
disagree with each other.

The five commits are 84263159f, 0235ff059, b7fcee9db, 1a1463028, and 6d889058c. Adjacent
non-sase-vd commits carry plausible, distinct plan paths, so this is not a global
regression — it looks like the launching agent's own `SASE_PLAN` environment value leaked
into the epic's phase-agent launches. `src/sase/agent/_family_attach_launch.py:46` sets
`env["SASE_PLAN"] = plan.sase_plan`, `src/sase/axe/run_agent_exec_finalize.py:121` pops it,
and `src/sase/workflows/commit/commit_tracking.py:226` reads it at stitch time; one of
those does not cover the epic-phase launch path.

Impact: `SASE_PLAN` is a durable provenance tag. The ACE commit modal
(`modals/commit_view_modal.py`), `sase.plan_documents.load`, and
`sase.sdd.plan_header_refresh` all resolve a commit's plan from it, so for this epic they
resolve the wrong document, and archaeology on a landed epic follows a false trail.

FOUND BY: the sase-vd land agent while reading the epic's commits to verify phase work.

task_type_fields.impact: Commit provenance lies for a whole epic: the ACE commit modal, sase.plan_documents.load, and sase.sdd.plan_header_refresh all resolve the wrong plan document from the tag.
task_type_fields.repro: `git log --grep sase-vd --format=%b | grep SASE_PLAN` on master prints `SASE_PLAN=[202608/agents_v2_a_annotations.md]` five times, while `sase bead show sase-vd` links `plan:202608/one_workspace_per_agent_family.md`. The `SASE_BEAD=` tag on the same commits is correct.
